summary: Binance Wallet launched an in-wallet TCG Gacha with Pokémon as its first card pool, the closest thing yet to Solflare Packs on another chain. Solflare Packs talk kept coming from the Charizard and Fire Friends pack, mostly from ambassadors and small accounts, with one post using '$250 to $88k' flip framing. On Solana, a stats post said the chain took 61.5% of global TCG gacha spend in Q3 and Collector Crypt passed $1B in cumulative volume. Collector chatter: Flowing Fists restocks selling out, One Piece misprints, bad hobby boxes, and the PSA backlog (one account says it's down to 6.1M).
